desc: Implement the solution: Read N, X, Y, S, T. Check if total counts of '0' and '1' match. If not, print No. If yes, check if the sequence of run lengths modulo X (for '0' runs) and modulo Y (for '1' runs) is identical for S and T. If identical, print Yes, else No. Handle edge cases where X+Y > N or no operations are possible (though the modulo check covers most, strict equality is needed if no swaps can occur).
